name: Surya US Accent Clone
description: Surya's voice timbre with a US English accent, for global audiences.
use_for: Global topics (SBTi, ISSB, CSRD, global carbon markets) and international audiences.
pipeline: Kokoro US-English TTS (accent and prosody) -> kNN-VC voice conversion (WavLM-Large layer-6 features, k=4 nearest neighbours from Surya's recording, pre-matched HiFi-GAN vocoder, 16 kHz).
consent: Built from Surya's own recording with his authorisation, for ReGeneva narration only. Never commit or share the recordings.

env.KNNVC_DIR: kNN-VC repo files (matcher.py, knnvc_utils.py, wavlm/, hifigan/)
env.SURYA_MATCH_WAV: Surya's polished 16 kHz recording (outside the repo)

downloads.python: pip install torch==2.6.0 torchaudio==2.6.0 kokoro-onnx soundfile

status: Configured, not yet validated. Running the third-party kNN-VC code needs explicit user permission in this environment.
